verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents default load-balancing across top providers for uptime, a `provider` object to customize routing order/preferences, automatic model/provider fallbacks, sticky routing after caching, and BYOK plus programmatic key management for distributing keys — together covering weight/latency/cost-oriented routing and key rotation. Community posts corroborate default fallback behavior in production. missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of sorting providers by latency or cost as named parameters, and independent benchmarks validating weight/latency-based routing claims.
